user.title: Cambridge Audio Azur 851
user.description: Choose the model and the serial port the amplifier is connected to. ESPHome serial proxies (e.g. a Home Assistant Connect AUX-2) appear in the list once the ESPHome device is set up in Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Azur 851
reconfigure.description: Update the model or serial port for this device.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.no_response: The serial port opened, but the amplifier did not respond. Check it is connected to this port, the cable/wiring (TX/RX), and that the correct model is selected.
